title: Fasting Window Start-Time Drift
dataSources: Alcohol habit events (`habit:alcohol`), caffeine intake (`habit:caffeine`), screen-time sessions (`habit:screen`), and fasting windows (`habit:fasting`).
app: Habit-boundary telemetry for Dry January, caffeine cutoffs, screen-before-bed limits, and fasting windows sent to Splunk HEC via apps, shortcuts, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=habit:fasting
| search start_offset_min=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(start_offset_min) as avg_start_offset_min max(start_offset_min) as max_start_offset_min by _time weekday
| sort - _time
description: Tracks fasting start-time drift over time and breaks it out by weekday.
value: Start-time drift shows whether the eating window has quietly become too negotiable to mean much.
implementation: Send fasting start-time drift events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of fasting start-time drift by weekday.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how fasting start-time drift changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
